balls.text: Four for Muzarabani. Short and wide, pace off again, and Shivang can only chip it to cover. We have the highest total of IPL 2026 already, but will that be enough for SRH?
Creamed through point! Debutant Shivang Kumar starts off with a blistering boundary. Wide full toss, it was quite low, and he just nails the square drive

Picks out deep midwicket. Muzarabani has his third. Pace-off, full and wide. Klaasen has to reach out as he tries to go over the leg side but ends up dragging it straight to long-on. This was at 104kph!
Past the diving fielder! Goes across to this full toss outside off and whips it square. First fifty of the season for him
Oh, he's found the gap. This is a pace-off back of length delivery, Klaasen pulls it off the toe end and gets it straight enough to beat long-on
That lands in the gap! Klaasen looks to go downtown as Muzarabani goes full outside off at 130kph. Long-on and long-off are running in but it falls right between them
Goes full and wide but past the tramline

And Dubey finds the boundary again! Full outside off, 134kph, Dubey swings it away in the gap at deep square leg. 20 runs off his two overs, but two wickets and generally, some good death bowling from the KKR quick
Oh, so neatly done by Harsh Dubey! He shuffles across the stumps very early as Vaibhav goes full and pace-off. Waits on it and scoops it fine on the leg side with short fine up
Slower bouncer outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
134kph low full toss on the stumps, clipped out to deep square leg
Angles a 137kph length ball across him and ends up firing it down leg as Dubey has a swipe. Called wide

Knocks him over first ball! Arora's brilliant spell at the death continues. Nails this yorker, and Salil Arora has to make the long walk back the way he came from. Fired in at 138kph in the blockhole, Arora was looking to whip it across the line and is beaten by the pace. The ball goes off his pads and onto the stumps

Reddy's second life lasts just one ball. Wide slower ball bouncer and Reddy has to wait on it and tries to carve it over point. But there's a fielder in the deep and it's Varun again in the thick of it all, and this time he makes no mistake. Quick respite for him

Varun juggles and drops it! Reddy fires a second consecutive full toss but straight towards Varun at deep midwicket. The ball just pops out of his hand at the first go as he crouches to get behind it and he dives forward to try and grab it on the second attempt. But the ball pops out again and there's no third time lucky for Varun there either. But SRH have reviewed this for waist-height full toss. And it's confirmed to be a fair delivery. 16 runs off the over

Pulled into the gap! This is a juicy full toss and Reddy stands tall and pulls it high in the air. Doesn't get the distance, but it lands in the gap between deep midwicket and long-on converging for a one-bounce four.
Nicely done by Reddy! Full and aimed at the blockhole, seam-up and drifting down leg, Reddy has to adjust his balance but manages to get a chunk of the ball as he clips it fine on the leg side
Tyagi sees the reverse-lap plan and counters it with a slower bouncer going away from Klaasen. The batter pulls it into the ground and towards long-on
This time, Klaasen nails the reverse-lap! Very full outside off at 141kph, Klaasen ends up hitting it very fine on the off side and it goes all the way
Oooh, so close! Looks for the yorker just outside off, ends up a full toss. Klaasen looks for a reverse lap and misses it altogether and the ball juuuuust misses the base of off stump

And there you go! Looks for the yorker but errs in length. Reddy clears his front leg and launches this slot ball on off straight down the ground. The over ends with a six, but still, it was pretty good stuff from Vaibhav Arora
Banged in short and aimed at Reddy, who swivels and looks to hook. Can't connect
Low full toss, Klaasen can only flick it away through square leg
Excellent from Arora! 135kph yorker on the stumps. Klaasen just about manages to keep it out
Goes high in the air, but doesn't carry to long-on. Vaibhav bowled this in the slot on middle at 135kph, and Reddy will feel he missed out there
Bangs in a short ball at 120kph following Klaasen who was making room on the leg side. Klaasen swats it away to deep midwicket on the bounce
Back of length outside off, his slowest of the day at 115.8kph, pulled to deep midwicket. Just seven runs off the over, including a wide. Not bad at this stage of the innings
Full and wide, and it goes past the tramline. Up go the umpire's arms
Low full toss around off, 140kph, driven down to long-on's left. Green comes around
Goes for the wide yorker, Klaasen reaches out and eases it to deep point
Low full toss outside off as he attempts another yorker, and Reddy steers it out to deep point
Very good ball. Around yorker length outside off. Klaasen digs it out towards long-on
Short and wide, pace off at 117kph, pulled on the bounce to long-on

Fifty partnership up, with a bit of confusion. Klaasen steers this length ball towards point where Tyagi doesn't pick it up cleanly. Had he done so, there may have been a chance at the non-striker's end as Klaasen was slow to start on the run. Eventually the throw is also a bad one and the overthrow gifts SRH another run
Now Klaasen gets low on a full delivery around off and spinning across him and sweeps him very fine. Deep backward square was a long way across and can't stop it
Punched down to long-on
Not Rahane's day in the field! Full outside off, Reddy hits a cover drive. Rahane, moving to his left, over-runs it and slips as he gets low to stop that and the ball goes through
Short and wide, Klaasen pulls it tamely to long-on. Jumps in anger as he takes his run, feeling he missed out on a chance for a big one
A bit short outside off, fired in at 95kph, Reddy rocks back and pulls it out to deep midwicket
Short and wide, flat-batted off the toe end to long-on
Wide yorker outside off, Klaasen jams his bat down to squeeze it out towards point
Full outside off, driven out to deep cover
Banged in short and wide, pace off again, Reddy waits on it and cuts it out to deep point
Looks for a yorker but it ends up a 131kph low full toss. Chipped to long-on on the bounce. Klaasen's top hand came off the bat there in the follow-through
Back-of-length slower ball outside off, Klaasen has a swipe but is done in by the lack of pace. No contact
Full outside off and spinning in, slowed down to 85.3kph. Reddy looks for a drive on the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads
Driven away to the sweeper cover fielder
Length ball spins in from outside off, Klaasen clips it through square leg. They easily pick up two
Full outside off, Reddy works it to long-on
Rocks back to this short-ish ball and scuffs a pull to deep square leg
Just evades a leaping cover fielder! Back-to-back boundaries for SRH. Backs away to a length ball following him down leg and punches it flat and over the fielder
Thrashed through cover, and a boundary after a long break! Width on offer, Reddy leans across and thrashes a drive on the up through cover
Another yorker-length delivery, Klaasen digs it out towards long-on
Goes too wide again
Short and wide, Klaasen slaps it away to deep cover's right
Nice little yorker from Anukul. Dug back to the bowler
Goes fuller and wide again, close to the tramline. This time it's not given
Short, and wide and spinning away. Klaasen leaves it alone. Umpire calls wide
Klaasen backs away and Anukul follows him with a full ball down leg. Klaasen whips it wide of long-on and they do well to run two
Punched down to long-on again. Varun will feel good this over went for just six runs. Maybe a good time for KKR to get an over out of him as well, after SRH lost three wickets in the last two overs.
Pitches this one up for the first time in the over, Reddy leans into it and drives to long-off
On a length outside off and angling in, fired in flat and fast, Klaasen stands tall and punches it down to long-on
Full and quick on off, clipped through midwicket
On a length close to off, punched down to long-on
Ball spins in from outside off, tucked through square leg
short again, and wide outside off again. Slashed to deep cover point, where a fumble from Arora hands SRH another run
short in length, and only slightly wide of off. Cut away to deep-backward point
on a length in and around off. Punched powerfully to long-off
a fullish ball on off, and it straightens. He goes back to clip to square leg

Rinku takes another good catch!! KKR are back into the contest. SRH have to rebuild. Anukul teased Aniket by going on a short of a length, and wide of off. Aniket went slashing away from his body and lofted it wide of long-off, but Rinku, at the long-off boundary, moved swiftly to his left to pouch the ball. It's all going KKR's way suddenly
angles it in, and bowls on a length on middle. Aniket looked to whip, but was hit on his back leg
another slower ball. This is on a fullish length outside off. Aniket goes back to nudge towards square leg

slower ball, and outside leg. It's not given wide, and Aniket reviews. Rahane uses the time to have a word with his team-mates. Meanwhile, Muzarabani bowled it on a short of a length, and got the ball to shape back in and finish outside leg. Aniket looked to pull but missed, and the ball went below his bat. Wide called by the third umpire, as the ball was well clear of bat and pad
four leg byes. Short of a length on middle, and Aniket, who's deep in the crease, looks to pull from leg, but the ball takes his thigh pad and beats the keeper to his left

great catch by Varun!! He isn't doing it with the ball at the moment, but he does it really well on the field. But wait. Abhishek is hanging around to check for the cleanliness of the catch, as it's referred by the umpire. Varun was at deep square leg, and went low to try and catch the ball, which was dipping on him. The third umpire checks multiple replays from multiple angles, even as it appears that Varun's hands are beneath the ball. But we'll wait for that confirmation. Repeated change of angles finally satisfies the third umpire. He gives it out, and Eden roars. Abhishek walks back frustrated
short in length, and finishing on leg. A mistimed pull to short fine leg's left

well taken by Rinku at the deep cover-point boundary!! He tip-toes on the fence, but his left leg doesn't touch the boundary. Short of a length from Muzarabani, who got the ball to climb outside off. Kishan looked to slash at it aerially by riding the bounce, and nearly timed it all the way for six
on a length at just 110kph. Abhishek chips it to deep midwicket after going back in the crease
"Ohhhh", comes the cry from Kishan as he's beaten. Shorter side of a length at 145kph around sixth stump from Tyagi, as Kishan looked to jab at it but missed
nearly chopped on!! Slower ball on a back of a length on leg. Kishan went pulling, but got a bottom edge on to his pad
clears a leaping mid-off. This time the length is full, and on off. Kishan hangs back, and lofts back through the line
four more - this time to deep third. Kishan reaches out for this yorker-length ball wide of off, and slices it to beat point to his right. Great timing there
pulled to deep square leg. He finds the gap between the men at deep backward square leg and deep midwicket. Short ball again from Tyagi, and Kishan pulls it hard from outside off
short of a length, and just outside off. Kishan looks to cut, but the ball doesn't get up that much, and he's beaten
now he goes back at this length ball which is slower, and turning away to finish wide-ish of off. Cut away to deep-backward point
flung away for six more. Length ball outside leg, and much quicker from Narine. But Abhishek dispatches it over deep-backward square leg
full and slower on middle, and popped up towards point
bam!! Slashed to deep extra cover. Shortish in length on middle, and turning away. But Abhishek swats at it late to beat the man at deep cover
on a length on leg, and turning away to finish around middle. Whipped to deep midwicket
fullish ball on middle, and pushed to cover
well timed, but straight to the man at deep third, who moves to his right to stop the ball. Fullish ball slightly wide of off, and Abhishek opens the face of the bat to guide that
fires a low full toss on off at 144kph. The ball angles across, and Kishan droves it towards extra cover

Eden finally finds its voice!! Green at mid-on moves back a few steps and takes the catch with a reverse cup. Short of a length at 142kph from Tyagi, who bowls this around seventh stump. Head looks to swat it back down the ground, but loses his bottom hand off the bat. The ball is ballooned up without timing, and Head falls after 46 off 21 balls
cramps Head for room. KKR will love the dot ball. Head is squared up by this short-of-a-length ball at 145kph on leg, as he fends it towards point
change of pace, but still six. Full delivery just outside off, and Head crushes the ball over extra cover. He reads the lack of pace perfectly
too full, and too wide. Tyagi bowls this around ninth stump outside off, and Head still chases after it but misses
change in bowling, but nothing changes for KKR. Short in length on leg from Tyagi, and Head backs away to swat that through extra cover
a carbon copy of the previous ball. Varun bowls on a length, and really wide of off. But Abhishek gets across, and just gently slashes it between point and cover yet again
he gets across, and finds the gap between point and cover. Varun saw Abhishek moving, and went short of a length and wide of off. But Abhishek read the line, and deposited the ball in the gap
wide outside off. Varun floats this very full, and wide of off. Abhishek lets it go
flayed away over extra cover. Very powerful from Abhishek. He goes down on his back leg, and drills this full and wide ball outside off for four
short again, and six again!! Varun looks clueless and helpless. He bowls it just outside off, and Abhishek clatters this hard and deep into the crowd beyond long-on
quicker ball, and shortish in length on off. Punched to extra cover
crashed over long-on!! Abhishek continues Varun's misery. On a length around leg, and finishing on middle, as Abhishek clears his front leg to ram that
on a length on leg, and pushed back

tough chance for Rahane!! He was at extra cover, and turned halfway to his right while backpedalling. The ball, though, arrived wide of his hands as he looked to dive to his side. Head had lofted this full delivery after skipping down the ground, but mistimed it
same line for Head. Outside leg, as the ball is on a fullish length. Head clips to short fine leg
fuller side of a length, and outside leg yet again. Abhishek goes back to nudge to midwicket
on a length on leg again, and this time Abhishek punches it to extra cover after backing away
full and slow, as the ball dips on leg. It turns away a bit, and Abhishek pushes it back
another attempt at a ramp, but he's beaten this time. Arora cramps Head for room by going short of a length, and angling the ball into leg
too high, and wide called. A slower ball from Arora, who bowls a bouncer on middle. Head attempts to upper but misses
over point, and Eden is silenced yet again. A low full toss angling into off, and Head slices it expertly over the fielder at point. Arora is shocked

bam!! Over the man at deep backward square leg. Full ball angling in again, but the length is way outside leg. Head, though, is standing outside leg, and utilises the length to liberally swing his arms for another six
the ball goes over the SRH dugout down the ground!! Head gets his front leg out of the way, and launches at this full delivery angling into middle. Huge hit
straight to the man at extra cover. Finally a dot for Head. Arora lands this on a yorker length on the stumps, and Head drives this after backing away a bit
thumped between mid-off and extra cover. Rahane, at the former position, thought of a chase but gave it up. Head clears his front leg, and bashes this length ball from outside off

the first six of the day!! The ball flies over the deep square-leg boundary. Muzarabani again decides to go short, and gets punished. The ball lands on middle, and Abhishek gets on top of the bounce to pull from off. Huge over for SRH
short delivery from Muzarabani to Abhishek. The ball lands on leg, and finishes on off, as Abhishek dabs it down
change of pace from Muzarabani. His length is also full this time. He bowls it on leg, and Head waits for the ball to move away, before jabbing to deep-backward point

just over the man at cover point. Head isn't timing the ball all that well, but the power and the outfield are doing it for him. Short of a length, and rising on top of sixth stump. Head rides the bounce, and swats it through the line
slapped to deep cover point!! Head gets back-to-back boundaries. Short in length from Muzarabani, who also gives Head width. Head shifts his weight back, and slams it through cover
angled across, but straightening off a full length on middle and leg. Clipped to deep square leg

swiped to the deep-midwicket boundary. Short in length, and pitching outside leg - so the line isn't great this time. Head swivels and pulls after letting the ball seam away. SRH get their first boundary

fumble at point, and Abhishek is off the mark. Short of a length on leg, and shaping away to finish outside off. Abhishek punches, and the man at point dives to his right and gets a hand, but doesn't collect the ball cleanly
finally Head gets bat on ball. Fullish delivery this time, and on the stumps. Head waits for it to move away, before pushing it to deep third
nicely bowled again!! Head looks to jab at this short-of-a-length ball landing on leg, but the ball seams away to end close to off. There's good bounce for Arora again, and Head is beaten
looks to slash but is beaten. Some extra bounce for Arora. This is short of a length on middle, and shapes away to go over Head's bat
leaves the first ball alone. Fuller side of a length, angling across to pitch on leg, but seaming away to finish outside off

Gone, first ball and SRH are on the board! Quick yorker outside off, 130kph. Varun got the bat down but ends up inside-edging it onto the stumps. KKR are knocked over for 161 and SRH register a big, big victory

Gone! Umpire reckons Tyagi has nicked behind, but he's reviewed it. Full outside off, Tyagi was looking to work it leg side. There was a noise as the ball went past the inside edge. Kishan was convinced, so was Unadkat and so was the umpire. And UltraEdge confirms it. KKR go nine down
Full outside off, Vaibhav manages to push it into the cover region
130kph length ball goes past the outside edge as Arora makes a tame push at it. Very tail-ender-ish effort from Vaibhav
Slower bouncer outside off, Tyagi backs away and waits on it before swatting it down to long-on
Lovely slower ball, full outside off, nearly takes the outside edge as Tyagi prods at it
Another one goes. Another catch for Unadkat. Pace-offf length ball at 108kph, Ramandeep waits on it and gets low to slash it away, but hits it straight to backward point

Ouch, I think that pinged his helmet. He tries to duck under a 137kph short ball but can't evade it in time. The ball went towards long leg, allowing them the run. And now the physio comes on for an examination
Tyagi starts off with a boundary! 136kph, but drifting down leg. He just has to get some bat on it and it runs away fine on the leg side

This time it's taken at long-on. Aniket Verma the fielder. Malinga went for the blockhole with pace off. Narine can't quite get under it as he tries to loft it down the ground. Aniket gets behind the line and makes a timely jump to grab it above head height, while making sure the momentum doesn't take him over the rope
Pulls his length back but keeps the plan the same - to keep it out of Narine's arc. He has a swipe but can't touch it
Another slower ball, with the same plan, and again it's gone past the tramline

Flung full and wide at 105kph, going across Narine, who leaves it expecting the wide to be given. It is not, and KKR review. Looked fine to me on first viewing. Let's see what the third umpire has to say. And KKR are justified as the review shows it was just on the wide line
Starts with a 137kph short ball and Ramandeep is hurried as he tries to pull. Goes off the top edge and lands short of deep midwicket running in

Palmed over the rope! Harsh Dubey can't hold on at long-on! Slower ball, full on off. Narine takes it on and goes down the ground. Dubey leaps up, a few steps inside the rope, while running to his right, but can't quite get his hands behind the ball
First ball six! Pace-on short ball sits up nicely and Narine just swivels and pulls it off his hips over square leg

Edged to short third! Is that the game for KKR? Slower ball does the trick again. Full outside off and Rinku flashes at it. Goes off the toe end of the bat straight to Unadkat at short third and he takes a neat catch falling to his right
Reddy goes short outside off at 122kph. Ramandeep looks to flat-bat it down the ground but it hits the bat high and lobs up towards mid-off, but doesn't carry. Lucky there, the batter
Full outside off, pace off, and it's tucked through square leg
Back of length outside off, chopped to backward point
Googlu outside off, Rinku punches it out in front of point
Lofted beautifully over wide long-off! In the slot on off and he just makes room and flays it over extra cover
Another misfield. This time it's not too expensive. Ramandeep cuts away this short-ish ball to point, where the fielder lets it through him, but there was cover in the deep
Full on off, Rinku works it in front of point for a single
Wrong'un on a length outside leg, Ramandeep nudges it into the vacant midwicket region for two
Hammered over short third! Flighted full on off and Ramandeep was ready early for the reverse-sweep. Got all of that there
Back of length outside off, Ramandeep shuffles across and looks to whack it down the ground. Only ends up chipping it to mid-off on the bounce
Full-ish outside off, punched to point. No single there
Length ball jags in from outside off, Rinku punches it out on the off side for a quick single
Short ball angled into him, Ramandeep stands tall and pulls it out to deep square leg

Nicked behind, NKR strikes second ball! Shorter side of good length just outside off, with the seam up. Anukul tries to run it down fine on the off side and ends up with a thick edge and Kishan gobbles it up as a pumped up Reddy veers away in celebration
Back of length outside off, Anukul wafts at it but can't get bat on it

Mix-up, and after all that, Raghuvanshi is run-out in the end! Rinku slashes this to backward point and takes off, but is also ball-watching and doesn't quite commit to the run. Raghuvanshi has run more than half the length of the pitch when Rinku stops and can't really scramble back in time. Rinku says it was Raghuvanshi's call. Good throw, close to the stumps at the non-striker's end and Shivang does the rest
Another wrong'un, but it was too short. Rinku backs away and cuts it away crisply through point. He's been targeting this shot through the over, and this time gets it through for a boundary
Driven wide of long-off for a single
Wrong'un spins in from a length outside off, cut away to backward point
oh, shot! Backs away to this slot ball on off and lofts it wide of long-off
Rinku backs away and slashes this googly on a length to backward point
wide outside off, and on the shorter side of a length. Rinku slashes to deep point
pulled away to deep square leg. This time the slower ball doesn't work. Short ball pitching around sixth stump at just 103kph, and Rinku pulls after letting the ball seam in
Payne keeps bowling at a lack of pace. Shorter side of a length on off, and punched to point
another slower ball. This is on a length, and wide of off. Cut away to deep point
good running. Short ball at just 109kph, and pulled from wide of off. Rinku swats it to long-on, where Klaasen collects the ball
short ball at a lack of pace. Raghuvanshi pulls from sixth stump to deep square leg to raise fifty
short ball around off, and turning in. Slashed to extra cover

Ohh!!! It's now Reddy's turn to misfield. What is happening?! Rinku lofted this full ball from leg, and got it to deep extra cover. Reddy over-ran to his right, and fumbled eventually, as the ball turned to his left
much fuller and slower, and driven off the outside half of the bat from off. Now Payne misfields at short third, and KKR get three instead of one

a confident appeal for caught behind by Kishan, but turned down. Kishan reviews, though. But there's no bat involved, as Raghuvanshi went cutting and the ball beat his bat comfortably. It was another short ball from Shivang
Dubey's misfield hands Raghuvanshi a four. Short again, and turning away to finish wide of off. Raghuvanshi cuts it late for the ball to reach deep point
short in length, and cut away from outside leg to cover
short delivery pitching wide of off, but finishing closer to off. Pulled to deep square leg
fuller side of a length, and just outside off. Punched to deep cover
beats short third, but can't beat deep third. Shivang runs and dives to his left at the boundary to stop two. Raghuvanshi guided this length ball from outside off to beat Malinga at short third
punched to deep-backward point. Great timing. Shortish in length, and he rides the bounce to play it late from off stump. Good effort by Nitish at the boundary, as he dives to his left
down the pitch, and on the bounce to deep cover rushing forward. Shorter side of a length, and outside off from Unadkat. Rinku slashes but mistimes
extra bounce!! Length ball around sixth stump, and Rinku is beaten as he looks to jab

sliced aerially over point. No timing there, as he's perhaps beaten by the lack of pace, and the flight. Full ball dipping just outside off, as Raghuvanshi barely beats the fielder for four to deep point
short in length on middle and leg, and punched to point
beaten!! There's a mild appeal for stumping as well. Shivang angled it across, and went on a fullish length outside off. Raghuvanshi went driving but missed, and Kishan whipped the bails off
full and slower, and on middle. Pushed to long-on
quicker ball, and hits Rinku on his pad outside leg as he looks to pull this short ball but misses
fullish and flat on middle and leg. Rinku gets a leading edge as he looks to flick

wow, he's run out this time!! Raghuvanshi gave up midway into the run, as Malinga whipped the bails off at his end. This is what happened earlier: Malinga bowled it full, as Raghuvanshi drove it back. Malinga fumbled, though, as the ball flicked off his boot and dribbled back. Hang on!! Just as Raghuvanshi made his way to the boundary to walk back, he's stopped to confirm who's the batter who's actually out as the batters crossed while Malinga broke the stumps. And guess what? It's Green who's out. Damn!! What luck!!

ohhh, there's a massive mix-up as Malinga and Raghuvanshi collide!! Green punched this short-of-a-length ball back to Malinga's right, as the bowler and the non-striker got into a mess, with Raghuvanshi rushing for a run. Eventually, though, Malinga threw to Kishan as Raghuvanshi dived back in
lack of pace, and short in length just outside off. Punched to cover point for a rapid single. The throw is wide of the stumps at the bowler's end
he's hit on the box. Ohh! Short in length on middle and off, and Raghuvanshi opened his stance up to nudge but missed
three wides now in the over. This one's for height. Bouncer around sixth stump, as Raghuvanshi leaped to try and upper but this slower ball, but missed
short of a length on off, and punched to mid-on
wide called. A bouncer from Malinga, who asks Kishan if it's worth a review. But the captain doesn't. Green jumped down the pitch and ducked, as the ball seamed in to finish on top of leg
slower ball, and much fuller on off. Driven to mid-off for a hurried run
starts with a wide. On a short of a length on middle, and seaming in to finish outside leg. Raghuvanshi looked to nudge but missed

Good catch by Malinga!! Short of a length around middle, as Unadkat bowls a slower ball. The ball seamed away, and Rahane went for the pull - but the bounce wasn't much off the pitch because of the lack of pace, and the ball went off the top edge. Malinga did well running in from deep midwicket, and took a sliding catch
another bouncer. This pitches outside leg, and swat-pulled to midwicket from off stump
slashed between point and short third. Expertly finds the gap with a late cut. Short of a length on leg, and he plays it from middle stump despite playing so late
rolls his wrists, and pulls for four. Bouncer just outside leg, and he pulls from in front of his head to beat short fine leg to his left
slower ball, and on the fuller side on middle. Nudged to point
on a length, and pulled from just outside off to mid-on. Rahane is lacking in timing so far, as this came off the bottom of the bat
another mistimed swipe from Rahane. He swipes this full delivery on off to deep midwicket
fullish ball on off, and dabbed to point
lofted inside out. Full and just outside off, as Raghuvanshi goes over wide long-off
superb agility from Dubey. He sticks his right boot out, and takes the blow, as Rahane drills back a full ball. The ball deflects to the right for a single
full delivery on off, and straightening. Pushed to point for a hurried single
full ball on off, and slogged to deep midwicket
another six. This time he fetches a full and quick ball from off, and sweeps the ball turning into him for a six over fine leg. An extension of the arms from Raghuvanshi
on a fullish length on middle and leg, and swept to short fine leg. Mistimed from Rahane
full ball on leg, and angling down further. Rahane looks to clip but is hit on his pad outside leg
very full, and he backs away to drive to long-off from leg stump
uses his wrists, and bang!! Six over long-on. This full ball dips on leg, and Raghuvanshi swings at it late to get a big six
short in length, and pitching outside off. The ball turns away a bit, and slammed to point

animated appeal for lbw, but turned down. Kishan and Dubey discuss... but don't review. Arm ball from Dubey, as Raghuvanshi went sweeping but was hit on his pad. That seemed to be heading down the leg side
wide down the leg side, and Rahane and Raghuvanshi run as well. Angled in, and full outside leg. Rahane looked to sweep but missed
full again, but flatter on off. Driven to long-off
quite full, and slower. This ball dips just outside off, and is driven back to Dubey

got him!! Slammed back hard, and Dubey is alert. Relief for SRH. Dubey did well to react and catch quickly, as Allen went slogging at this full ball wide of off, but ended up getting it off the toe-end of the bat. Chance for SRH to break KKR's flow
lofted over mid-off!! Allen keeps pumping. Quite full, and around off, as Allen clears his front leg to dispatch that
angled into a full length on middle and off. Dragged to wide mid-on by Rahane
between point and cover point. KKR have 25 on the board in the first over. This time Allen slashes a length ball arriving outside off, and plays it late to beat a diving point fielder
deep over deep-backward square leg!! The party at Eden has begun in the first over. Another short delivery - this is a slower ball - and Allen picks it up from around his waist to pull for six more
bang!! 4, 4, 6. Allen simply turns away after lofting this ball. It's on the fuller side, and around middle and off. Allen launches at it down the ground
pulled to deep square leg. Short delivery from Payne, who goes around off this time. Allen pulls after shifting his weight back
flayed away wide of mid-off!! No foot movement, but he reaches out at this length ball arriving just outside off, and bags four first ball
short of a length, as the ball angles across to arrive around fifth stump. Cut away to deep third
